findings.title: GHSA-4xm8-rg9h-jhq2: Signal K resources API path traversal discloses JWT signing secret and enables RCE
findings.summary_md: Path traversal in the Signal K resources and applicationData APIs lets an unauthenticated or low-privileged user read, write and delete files outside the storage root. Reading `/security.json` discloses the JWT signing secret, enabling admin token forgery and remote code execution. CVSS 3.1 score is 9.8 (AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H). Affected versions: >=1.0.0 <1.5.3. Fixed in 1.5.3. Published 2026-10-30.

findings.title: SignalK/signalk-server GitHub Security Advisory - GHSA-4xm8-rg9h-jhq2
findings.summary_md: GitHub advisory for the same path traversal vulnerability: unauthenticated access with `allow_readonly=true` leads to full server compromise via arbitrary JSON file read, admin token forgery, arbitrary command execution with server privileges, and persistent re-execution after restart. Validates `resourceId` against a strict whitelist (e.g., UUID format) in `src/api/resources/index.ts` before any storage call. Published 2026-10-18.
